source.content: @isTest private class DataCategoryLocalFixtureTest { @isTest static void localDataCategoryContract() { Schema.DataCategory category = new Schema.DataCategory(); category.name = 'Hardware'; category.label = 'Hardware'; System.assertEquals('Hardware', category.getName()); System.assertEquals('Hardware', category.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(0, category.getChildCategories().size()); } }
